FFmpeg version: 8.1.2
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
SHA-256: 464beb5e7bf0c311e68b45ae2f04e9cc2af88851abb4082231742a74d97b524c

The reproducible configure command is maintained in scripts/build_ffmpeg_ios.sh.
The build deliberately omits --enable-gpl and --enable-nonfree, disables
external codecs and network support, and enables only local-file Matroska
subtitle inspection/extraction dependencies, including the LGPL dvdsub
decoder used for local VobSub OCR.
